notes.title: 20241229Game Updata
notes.content:
[b]Optimizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Saving the game during battles is now possible.
[*] Expedition levels now increase the initial health of corresponding heroes by +1 for every 3 levels.
[*] Random Event: Abyssal Nest - Remove a random card → Choose one of three minions from your deck to remove.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where defeating the second and third-floor bosses did not complete achievements.
[*] Fixed an infinite damage loop against the Magic Mirror when holding the Lightning Curse talent.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Adjustments:[/h3]
[b]Enemy Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Defense: Gain Block 2 → Gain Block 1.
[*] Enhance: Randomly gain 1–2 Attack → Gain 1 Attack.
[*] Grinning Golem: Stats changed from 3/25 → 2/25.
[*] Boulder Throw: Deals 3 → 2 damage to an enemy within range 2.
[*] Mad Wizard: Stats changed from 2/25 → 2/20.
[*] Pineapple Kimo: Stats changed from 1/3 → 1/2.
[*] Naughty Jimmy: Stats changed from 1/25 → 1/20.
[*] Strange Box: Stats changed from 4/15 → 3/12.
[*] Captain Hook: Removed card {Defense} → Added card {Wild Slash}.
[*] Crazy Cat Dizzy: Stats changed from 1/4 → 1/3.
[*] String Master: Stats changed from 2/25 → 1/25.
[*] Black Chicken Kimo: Rush, Charge 1 → Rush only.
[*] Little Red Riding Hood: Stats changed from 4/25 → 3/25.
[*] Strawberry Kimo: Stats changed from 0/3 → 0/2.
[*] Infected: Stats changed from 2/45 → 2/40.
[*] Removed card {Seed Burst}, added card {Spore Mushroom Spit}.
[*] {Seed Burst} is now a special challenge card for Infected.
[*] Domination: Now removes mind control effects when taking damage.
[*] Treasure Guardian: Stats changed from 2/30 → 2/25.
[*] Reduced one card {Judgment Eye}.
[*] Snail Dragon: Stats changed from 2/35 → 1/30.
[*] Multi-Eyed Kid: Range 2, inserts one Neurotoxin card into the opponent’s deck when a spell is cast → Range 2.
[*] Added one more card {Mind Implant}.
[*] Promoted Reaper: Gains 1 Attack for each enemy unit that dies → Gains 1 Attack this turn for each enemy unit that dies.
[*] Twins: Deathrattle: Grants +1/+8 and Combo 2 to the other Twin → Grants Combo 2 to the other Twin.
[*] Reckless: Deals 3 damage to self and gains Combo 1 and 1 Attack → Deals 3 damage to self and gains Combo 1.
[*] Genie: Removed card {Magic Bullet Throw}, added card {Weathering}.
[*] Desert Caravan Survivor: Stats changed from 1/7 → 1/8.
[*] Edict: Removed card {Candlelight}, added card {Devour the Weak}.
[*] {Candlelight} is now a special challenge card for Edict.
[*] Big Mouth Monster: Stats changed from 2/5 → 2/4.
[*] The Cost of Healing: Destroys a friendly minion to restore 8 → 6 health to itself.
[*] Jupiter: Combo 1, Knockback 1, and Mind Control on attack → Knockback 1 and Mind Control on attack.
[*] Removed card {Wind Surge}, added card {Mind Implant}.
[*] Illusion: Chain: Grants +0/+5 → +0/+4 to a unit.
[*] Contract: Chain: Grants +3/+0 → +2/+0 to a unit.
[*] Bone with Giant Axe: Stats changed from 0/45 → 0/40.
[*] Rapid Strike Sword: Gains Charge 1. Weapon changes to a sword with Combo 2 (3/4) → a sword with Combo 2 (2/4).
[*] Judgment Fire: Deals 3 → 2 damage to all other units.
[*] Ground Dragon: Stats changed from 3/70 → 2/60.
[*] Small Ground Dragon: Stats changed from 3/6 → 2/6.
[*] Firefruit Dragon: Stats changed from 3/70 → 3/60.
[*] Dragon Crystal Fruit: Now removes control effects when taking damage.
[*] Nian Beast: Stats changed from 4/70 → 4/60.
[*] Mars Mosquito: Rush, Burn 1, returns to hand when attacked → Rush, returns to hand when attacked.
[*] Foraging Rockhouse Dragon: Stats changed from 5/75 → 4/75.
[*] Saturn: Stats changed from 2/6 → 2/4.
[*] Octa-Bat: Stats changed from 2/80 → 2/70.
[*] Large Dragon Larva: Stats changed from 2/6 → 1/6.
[*] Small Dragon: Stats changed from 3/6 → 2/6.
[*] Kingdom Gun: Stats changed from 1/25 → 1/20.
[*] Mutation: Gains Flying and Chant: At the start of the next turn, gain +2/+4 → +1/+3.
[*] Water Shield: Grants a friendly unit Shield 3 → Shield 2.
[/list]

[b]Player Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Archmage's Elemental Reaction: Damage increased from 2 → 3.
[*] Elemental Affinity (all levels): Mana cost reduced from 6 → 5.
[/list]

notes.title: 20241216 Updata
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some random events would persist after receiving rewards and closing the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the event interface could not be opened after clicking on and reaching the event location.
[*] Fixed an issue where Heroic Strike (and its upgraded cards) failed to restore health after killing an enemy hero.
[/list]

[h3]
Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[b]Enemy Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mad Chimo: Stats changed from 2/2 → 2/1.
[*] Spore Mushroom: Stats changed from 2/1 → 1/1.
[*] Mad Wildman Berserker: Stats changed from 1/5 → 1/4.
[*] Wuchiken Chimo: Stats changed from 3/4 → 2/4.
[*] Infector: Stats changed from 3/45 → 2/45.
[*] Snail Dragon Larva: Stats changed from 3/3 → 2/3.
[*] Green Alien: Stats changed from 2/4 → 1/4.
[*] Bone Bandit Leader: Stats changed from 3/50 → 2/45.
[*] Mad Sentinel: Stats changed from 3/1 → 2/1.
[*] Dragon Spearman: Stats changed from 2/2 → 1/2.
[*] Wandering Boy: Effect changed from “At the start of the turn, adjacent friendly units gain +2 attack this turn” → “At the start of the turn, adjacent friendly units gain +1 attack this turn.”
[*] Lady’s Iron Fang Bat: Effect unchanged (Applies Burn 1 on attack, range 2).
[*] Weathering: Effect changed from “Deals 6 damage, split among all enemies within range 2” → “Deals 4 damage, split among all enemies within range 2.”
[*] Soul Drain: Effect changed from “Randomly deals attack damage to an enemy unit and heals itself by the same amount, repeated 3 times” → “Randomly deals attack damage to an enemy unit and heals itself by the same amount, repeated 2 times.”
[*] Twins: Effect changed from “Deathrattle: Grants the other Twin +1/+8 and Combo 2” → “Deathrattle: Grants the other Twin +1/+8 and Combo 1.”
[*] Mountain Cleaver (Great Axe Bone): Effect changed from “Grants Leap 3. Equips a 6/2 cleaving axe” → “Grants Leap 3. Equips a 4/2 cleaving axe.”
[*] Dragon Rider Captain: Effect changed from “When flying, gains +2 attack and Rush 1” → “When flying, gains +1 attack and Rush 1.”
[/list]

[b]Player Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Book of Answers: Stats changed from 3/5 → 2/5.
[*] Homunculus in a Jar: Stats changed from 2/6 → 2/5.
[*] Cursed Wawa: Stats changed from 0/6 → 0/5.
[/list]

[*] Fixed an issue where Heroic Strike (and its upgraded cards) failed to restore health after killing an enemy hero.
